reserveReview.rationale: Reviewed 2026-10-01: the issuer's proof-of-reserves page names Ziraat Participation Bank and Akbank for EUROT euro reserves. Retrieved and visually read bank letters dated 2024-08-09 (Akbank) and 2024-08-08 (Ziraat Katılım) confirm Token Teknoloji euro balances alongside other currencies and assets. They are company balance certificates, not EUROT-specific reserve-to-liability reconciliations. The historical composition date is retained; no current bank allocation or safeguarding terms were established.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve banks are named, but the retrieved bank letters are dated 2024-08-09 and 2024-08-08 and cover Token Teknoloji multi-product balances. Current EUROT-specific reserve amounts, liabilities, bank-level allocation, liquidity terms, and safeguarding terms remain unverified.
